name: Hien no Tanken
source:
◆ A coming-of-age tale of a girl bound by fate
Years after the revolution, the newly founded nation of Kikoku—born from the ruins of a fallen dynasty—remains mired in unrest.

At the center of that darkness lies Hiseido, a secret organization rooted deep within the imperial capital.

From intelligence and purges to assassination, Hiseido carries out countless missions from the shadows.

Taken in by this organization, the young girl Takekosen now faces her final trial.

To abandon her old name, don the mask, and inherit the title of Hisei.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3997000/The_Dagger_of_Hisei/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
◆背负宿命的少女成长谭
革命数年之后，在覆灭王朝废墟上建立的新生国家——辉国，依旧深陷动荡之中。

处于这片黑暗核心的，正是深深扎根于京城暗处的秘密组织“飞星堂”。

从情报刺探、暗中肃清到刺杀行动，飞星堂在阴影之中执行着无数密令。

被该组织收留的少女武子璇，如今迎来了她最后的试炼——

舍弃昔日姓名，戴上面具，继承“飞星”之名号。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3997000/The_Dagger_of_Hisei/]Steam[/url]]
